Question ONE relates to Gigi's Games Galore. Refer to Resource Booklet A.

Complete the following general journal entries. Narrations have been provided.

Record the office wages owing: $1,500.
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Office wages 1,500 / Cr Accrued expenses 1,500.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct stem (account names). V: Correct $ amount for both entries.

questions.text:
Record the invoices issued for sales not yet recorded $1,610 including GST. The inventory cost price $640 excluding GST has been done for you.

(Cost of goods sold entry already provided: Dr COGS 640 / Cr Inventory 640)
questions.expectedAnswer: Dr Accounts receivable 1,610 / Cr Sales 1,400 / Cr GST payable 210.
questions.markingGuide: S: Correct account names. V: Correct amounts ($1,400 sales excl GST, $210 GST, $1,610 total). C: Correct Dr/Cr columns.

questions.text: Complete the prepayments general ledger account, showing all entries at 31 March 2024 including a closing entry if relevant.

questions.text: Complete the Income Statement for Gigi's Games Galore for the year ended 31 March 2024. You have been provided with the total for administrative expenses and do not need to complete this section.
questions.expectedAnswer: Revenue: Sales $482,300 less sales returns ($17,000) = Net sales $465,300.
questions.markingGuide: V: Correct figures. S: Correct account names/stems. C: Correct classification of items. T: Correct two-step calculations (e.g., COGS). P: Correct layout, subtotals, and fit for purpose.
